sections.name: ProvisionalBadge
sections.title: Provisional calibration warning badge
sections.what: Displays the warning badge with its default words and a marker that tests can find.
sections.why: Likely reason: honest labelling of probabilities that have not been adjusted, as the comment explains.
sections.watch_out: The projection style is shared with other badges, so restyling projections would also change this warning.

summary: A badge reading Provisional calibration, shown wherever a win chance or grade appears while the calibration check is a known issue.
purpose: Warns the user that the probabilities shown have not been adjusted to match real results.
why: The comment cites decision D-031 and gate F-E-04: the probabilities are shown as they are, not recalibrated.
how: Renders a badge with the given label, or the default text Provisional calibration, using the projection style and a test marker.
risks: The label can be replaced, so a caller could hide the warning text. It should stay in place until the calibration issue is fixed.
debug: If it still shows after a calibration fix, find where it is placed. The test marker provisional is what tests look for.
